kCAFG_cultural_benefits_character_base = {
	age = { 18 36 }
	gender_female_chance = {
        value = 50
        if = {
            limit = { scope:new_character_faith = { has_doctrine = doctrine_gender_male_dominated } }
            subtract = 25
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { scope:new_character_faith = { has_doctrine = doctrine_gender_female_dominated } }
            add = 25
        }
    }
	random_traits = yes
    culture = scope:culture
    faith = scope:new_character_faith
	dynasty = none
}
